title: LIVE Paris Masters | New World No.1 Alexander Zverev in blockbuster showdown against Lorenzo Musetti

 ATP by Lucas Michael Wednesday, 04 November 2026 at 13:00 Follow us on Google! 0 The second round at the Paris Masters is in full flow with the top seeds now entering the fray. The most noteworthy of them all is the World No.1 Alexander Zverev , who will step onto court with this esteemed number next to his name for the first time. He has not tasted success in a Masters 1000 event since the Paris Masters in 2024 and desperately seeks to end that drought. He has a very tough test for his opening match, pitched against Lorenzo Musetti , who is starting to find some form and rhythm back on court after a tumultuous 2026 campaign. Follow for live updates!
